source.text: As the closing-gap entry with a fuel a quarter as stiff as its cladding (E 5e10 against 2e11, the TRIGA fuel against steel is 0.3) and the penalty factor 0.7, the one that converges for such a pair. The same two-cylinder compliance form gives the pressure; FEED's penalty contact is known to give it 2.7 to 3.1 % low there.
source.check: FEED's sweep (docs/mechanics.md, 'What the contact sweep found'; the gated tests of tests/mechanicsSolver.test.ts assert the known limit). The tolerance of 2 % is below the known error on purpose: this entry records a limit and is expected to miss.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; axially fixed, a soft fuel (E 5e10), penalty factor 0.7
